name: Videoland
positioning: The largest local streamer in the Netherlands. Dutch-language focus. Part of RTL Group — high-budget tentpoles only happen when RTL linear is also commissioning. Videoland standalone commissions need to be cost-efficient and subscriber-driving.
evaluation_lens: Commercially minded senior commissioner. Evaluates through the lens of scale, platform fit, subscriber growth, and long-term strategic value — not purely creative enthusiasm. Asks: will this grow our subscriber base? Can it sustain multiple series? Does it have cultural event potential?

mandate.description: Videoland needs unscripted that drives subscriptions — content people sign up FOR, not content they watch because they're already a subscriber. The sweet spot is formats with broad cultural talkability, clear franchise potential, and a cost profile that doesn't require RTL linear co-commissioning.
actively_looking_for: Cost-efficient formats that can sustain 2+ series — the B&B Vol Liefde model
Content that genuinely appeals to men aged 18–30 — historically underserved on Dutch streaming
Social experiment or deception formats that aren't De Verraders — they own that format but it is currently oversaturated, so they need a fresh angle in this space
Event-style programming with broad Dutch cultural relevance — something the whole country talks about
Celebrity-led formats with a strong personality at the centre — De Verhulstjes, Only Joling model
True crime or investigative reality with long-form potential
Comedy-adjacent reality that attracts male viewers without being pure adventure/survival
slot_needs: Male 18-30 audience — biggest underserved slot on the platform
Cost-efficient returning format — needs more B&B Vol Liefde equivalents
Social experiment / deception — De Verraders is on pause due to oversaturation, need a fresh format in this space they own
mandate.tone: Emotionally authentic, culturally recognizable, Dutch. Not too niche. Should feel like something your whole family or friend group would talk about.

proven_formats: Ex On The Beach Double Dutch — dating chaos, strong 18-30 appeal, social media talkability
Echte Jongens Op Safari — male-skewing adventure, celebrity-led, cost-efficient
De Bachelorette — format acquisition, proven dating elimination structure
Real Housewives Of Het Zuiden — celebrity social reality, franchise model
De Verhulstjes — celebrity family docu-reality, warm, returnable
Kees van der Spek Ontmaskert — investigative reality, strong brand, returnable
Only Joling — legacy celebrity, nostalgia, broad appeal
what_works.note_on_rtl_shows: The Voice, Bureau Utrecht, Married At First Sight, and Pandora are RTL productions that appear on Videoland — they do not reflect Videoland's standalone commissioning appetite or budget. Do not pitch at this cost level for Videoland-only.

rejects: Concepts without strong long-form audiovisual value
Sports or live events unless major societal relevance
High-budget formats that require RTL linear co-commissioning to be viable
Ideas where the format engine is weak — personality alone is not enough
Anything that requires more than 2 sentences to explain the premise
cost_sensitivity: HIGH. Videoland standalone commissioning is cost-efficient by necessity. The B&B Vol Liefde model (one location, small cast, returning structure) is the benchmark. Adventure formats work because they can be shot cost-efficiently. Avoid anything requiring multiple international locations, large ensemble casts, or complex production infrastructure unless there is a clear RTL linear co-commission case.
